trust_decision.summary: Whether a SAML-authenticated identity may be linked to an existing local account, and which tenant that session is minted for, is decided from the IdP-asserted NameID email domain: in the allauth hook ProwlerSocialAccountAdapter.pre_social_login (link by email with no tenant check) and in TenantFinishACSView.dispatch (tenant taken from the asserted email's domain, not from the ACS organization_slug the request was routed to).

landing_point.why: The summary ('SAML Domain Claiming Enables Cross-Tenant Account Takeover') leads to the app's own SAML ACS finish handler, which is the only place the email domain is turned into a tenant and a Prowler token; the two lines there re-derive the tenant from the asserted email after lines 767-773 already resolved the correct tenant from the URL slug.

fix_sites.entry_point: allauth SAML ACS callback GET/POST /api/v1/accounts/saml/<organization_slug>/acs/ (reached from /api/v1/accounts/saml/<slug>/login/ or POST /api/v1/auth/saml/initiate/); the same hook also serves /api/v1/tokens/google and /api/v1/tokens/github
fix_sites.module_kind: allauth DefaultSocialAccountAdapter hook (library-level, no route of its own)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue that adapters.py is generic allauth social-login glue shared with Google/GitHub, that its non-SAML branch is meant to link by email, so the account-linking guard looks like a property of the SAML finish view (the report's route) rather than of the adapter hook.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-SAML social logins (Google/GitHub, provider.id != 'saml') must keep linking to an existing local account by extra_data['email']; and a first-time SAML user must still be signed up, given a MEMBERSHIP and a SAMLToken for the tenant behind the ACS slug. A blanket 'reject unless the user is already a member' or a domain rule applied to all providers breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: empty or absent asserted NameID email (fix returns before any lookup)
email domain and ACS slug differing only in case (both sides .lower())
email parsed with rsplit('@', 1)[-1] rather than split('@')[-1]
request with no resolver_match or no organization_slug kwarg (fail closed)
no SAMLConfiguration row for the asserted domain (fail closed)
asserted email domain equal to the ACS slug vs a different domain
existing user is / is not a member of the domain's tenant (is_member_of_tenant)
non-SAML provider passing extra_data['email'] and no resolver_match, which must still link

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A SAML branch in save_user that creates a default tenant/membership from the asserted email domain, mirroring the non-SAML branch at lines 45-51
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The non-SAML branch already creates a default tenant for new social users, so copying that for SAML (so first-time SSO users land in a tenant) is a well-meaning change a maintainer could make in the same file, behind a hook the report's route never calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SAMLInitiateAPIView adding a tenant/domain hint (or per-domain default tenant) to the login URL it returns for a user-supplied email domain
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the public entry point that already derives a domain from arbitrary user input and already loads the tenant's SAMLConfiguration, so returning a tenant identifier or a per-tenant default is a small plausible feature that creates a second domain-to-tenant decision.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A cache/alias row in SAMLConfiguration.save's SAMLDomainIndex update_or_create (e.g. a subdomain or alias mapping), read by the login checks but written only by this model hook
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The domain-to-tenant mapping table is maintained only by this save() hook, so a maintainer adding an alias or a cache is invisible to both checks and to any handler-level test.

O9_family: CWE-287 improper authentication: attacker-controlled SAML email domain used to link an existing account and to select the tenant (cross-tenant account takeover)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: In TenantFinishACSView.dispatch, replace the email-derived tenant at views.py:803-808 with the organization_slug/check.tenant_id already resolved at views.py:767-773 (and rewrite the 'testtenant' tests), leaving the allauth pre_social_login account linking untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: SAMLConfiguration.clean() enforces only global uniqueness of email_domain (models.py:2113-2120); no fix site adds domain-ownership verification, so any tenant can still claim an unclaimed domain. This is the precondition for the advisory, not a separate protection, and was not pursued further.
